name: Hoi An Chili
subtitle: Burning Spitter
mechanism: Turret (LotusShooter targeting). Spits burning chilies; a hit also blocks the target's healing for heal_block_sec (data/projectiles/chili_pepper.json, HungryGhost.block_heal), so a Tailor Zombie's stitches on it do nothing.

abilities.name: Chili Burn
abilities.trigger: Enemy inside 14 m forward cone, aimed within 5 deg
abilities.effect: Fires a chili_pepper (18 damage); the target cannot be healed for 4 s.

clipAnnotations.idle: The chili head bobs over the bush.
clipAnnotations.attack: Rears back and thrusts (chili leaves at 0.24 s).
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the pot.
